title: Unused-media check runs through the pre-commit config, not a dedicated lint.yml step
answers: where is the unused media check run in CI
which workflow checks for unused media files
how do I run the unused media check locally
where did the find-unused-media step in lint.yml go
body:
The unused-media check (dev/find-unused-media.sh) is a pre-commit hook with id `unused-media` in .pre-commit-config.yaml, not a step in .github/workflows/lint.yml.
CI coverage comes from running `pre-commit run --all-files`, which executes the hook against the whole repository.
Locally, run `pre-commit run unused-media --all-files` to check only this hook, or `pre-commit run --all-files` for the full set.
The hook ignores changed filenames (pass_filenames: false), so it checks the whole tree on every run.

search: The unused-media asset check (dev/find-unused-media.sh) executes as a pre-commit hook with id unused-media in .pre-commit-config.yaml rather than a dedicated step in .github/workflows/lint.yml. In CI, pre-commit run --all-files runs the hook across the repository, while locally developers can invoke pre-commit run unused-media --all-files. The hook sets pass_filenames: false to scan the entire tree on every run, and a separate lint.yml step must not be added to avoid duplicate runs.
